authority: official NASA/JPL Horizons VECTORS file API
source_review: Roots were independently solved on exact Horizons states, using historical reference epochs only as bracket seeds, without consulting Moira's apsidal solver.
Every numerical authority request included the candidate's actual first and last base-grid epochs; every root has opposite-sign two-sided radial-velocity witnesses.

Same-day unanchored controls reproduced the historical reference distances exactly for all four bodies, with the same JPL orbit solution labels. The historical references and anchored catalog are different integration-span products.
Anchored states agree with candidate radial distances to at most 0.000376553 km in this six-event sample. The unchanged distance gate is 0.1495978707 km (1e-9 AU), not 0.1496 metres.
Historical fixtures and their admission receipts were retained unchanged. This adds a separate reviewed authority product; it does not grant release admission or publish a catalog.
refresh_policy: Generate a new candidate directory with retained raw responses and controls, audit frame, center, TDB, integration endpoints, orbit solutions and hashes, and perform a separate source review. Never replace these files or widen gates in response to a failure.
limitations: This is a six-event, four-asteroid authority sample, not independent Horizons queries for all 11223 asteroids.
Captured generator text records the actual local research driver and paths, not a portable public builder command.
The diagnostic report's original not-baseline-promoted status records its creation stage; this review admits its anchored authority values only for validation-only integration.
